title: mono: core-shell, billing, reports pass owner = package.json team
Out of scope: README fake bucket names (lee said separate thing)

summary: validateApp now throws 'app.owner is required' when owner missing. core-shell/billing/reports pass owner matching their package.json team (platform/payments/insights), hardcoded since bundles can't read package.json. Assumptions: validateApp lives in monorepo libs/shared-contracts (inlined at build, no registry package), so no version bump/platformkit change needed; no external consumers exist. README fake-bucket-name cleanup left out as Lee called it a separate thing. PR #1 merged, CI+CD green.
